items.subject: art
items.title: Art Fundamentals: All-in-One Homeschool Art Curriculum
items.format: Printed book, 325 full-color pages, lay-flat comb binding
items.for: Ellie and Lillie (one book; each works in her own sketchbook)
items.why: Hands-on drawing and color skills that the Core Knowledge Art & Art History block is light on: line, pattern, shape, texture, value, color mixing and theory, positive and negative space, focal point. Short 20–30 minute lessons, each studying real artists.
items.notes: 4.6 stars from 32 reviews; shop has 260 sales. Two reviewers said the binding is weak. Needs only pencils and colored pencils (plus sketchbooks).
